description: This file defines the BookmarkFieldRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering bookmark fields into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering framework. It includes methods for rendering the bookmark start and end controls, as well as a static method for generating valid bookmark names according to RTF/Word constraints.

classes.name: BookmarkFieldRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for converting a BookmarkField object into RTF markup, encapsulating the rendering logic specific to bookmarks.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the bookmark into RTF controls, creating start and end bookmark controls with the validity-enforced bookmark name.

methods.name: MakeValidBookmarkName
methods.description: Generates a valid RTF bookmark name from the original name by enforcing naming constraints—starting with a letter and containing only letters, digits, or underscores.
